name: Deliveries to Sven
summary: In Darkshire, Elaine Carevin sends aid to Sven Yorgen's camp in northwestern Duskwood. Sven and his few followers struggle against the dangers of the blighted woods.

sections.title: A Lifeline to the Wilderness
sections.body: Sven Yorgen and a few companions keep a camp on Duskwood's northwestern frontier. Darkshire faces wolves, spiders, and restless dead, yet Sven's band holds its ground beyond the town's walls. Constant danger leaves them unable to spare anyone for the perilous journey back to town for provisions. Elaine Carevin arranges for travelers to carry supplies so the fighters can keep going.

sections.title: The Carevin Connection
sections.body: The Carevin family respects Sven and sees his stand as devotion to the Light. Elaine organizes and sends supplies to support his camp. When Sven receives the crate, he recognizes the Carevins' support, though his attention remains on the battle at hand.

faq.answer: Sven Yorgen is a frontiersman who keeps an armed camp on Duskwood's northwestern edge. Elaine Carevin regards him as an upright fighter serving the Light, and he and his small band face the terrors of the surrounding woods.

faq.q: Why does Sven need supplies brought to him?
faq.answer: Sven's small band must stay on guard against the dangers around them. They cannot spare anyone for the dangerous journey to Darkshire and back, so they rely on townsfolk and passing couriers for supplies.
Elaine Carevin provides supplies from Darkshire. Her family respects Sven's devotion and arranges aid for his camp.
Sven's camp lies against the northwestern mountains of Duskwood, far past the road and north of the blighted farmland, on the edge of the wilderness.

faq.q: Is this delivery mandatory before helping Sven further?
aliases: do i need deliveries to sven
faq.answer: No. Travelers who find Sven's camp on their own can help him without carrying Elaine's crate.

faq.q: What does Sven do after receiving the delivery?
faq.answer: Sven thanks the Carevin family for its support, then turns his attention to the threats facing his camp and his family's past. He seeks fighters to help him pursue vengeance.

angles.text: Outlying sentinels like Sven show how far the Alliance's reach has frayed in Duskwood, where voluntary couriers bring supplies instead of regular garrison lines.
Elaine sees Sven as a man doing the work of the Light. As a paladin, you can help a fellow fighter under siege.
The Carevins and Sven's followers show the grit of Stormwind's rural folk. As a human, you know they refuse to abandon Duskwood despite its gloom.
